scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Widow/Dependent in case of Death of a Worker- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Financial Assistance to Widow/Dependent in case of Death of a Worker scheme is a significant welfare initiative launched by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

This scheme was officially launched on January 1, 2010.

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial support to the widows or dependents of workers who die while in service.

The scheme aims to ensure that the families of deceased workers do not face financial hardships due to the sudden loss of their breadwinner.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is a one-time payment of ₹2,00,000.

This amount is intended to help the family manage immediate expenses and provide some financial stability during a difficult time.

The scheme is applicable to all workers who are registered under the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

Eligibility for this scheme requires that the deceased worker must have been actively employed at the time of their death.

The worker must have made contributions to the Employees’ Provident Fund or any other relevant social security scheme.

The applicant for the financial assistance must be the legal heir or dependent of the deceased worker.

This includes the widow, children, or any other dependent family member as defined by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

To apply for the financial assistance, the applicant must follow a specific process.

The first step is to obtain the application form from the Haryana Labour Welfare Board's official website or local office.

The applicant must fill out the form with accurate details regarding the deceased worker and their relationship to the applicant.

Along with the application form, the applicant must submit several required documents.

These documents include the death certificate of the worker.

The applicant must also provide proof of relationship to the deceased.

This can be in the form of a marriage certificate or birth certificates of children.

Additionally, the applicant must submit a copy of the worker's employment details.

This includes any proof of employment or registration with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

Once the application is complete with all necessary documents, it should be submitted to the nearest Haryana Labour Welfare Board office.

The application will be reviewed by the concerned authorities.

The processing time for the application is typically around 30 days.

If approved, the financial assistance amount of ₹2,00,000 will be disbursed directly to the bank account of the applicant.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board is responsible for implementing this scheme.

The board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Haryana.

The contact details for the Haryana Labour Welfare Board can be found on their official website.

The board has various regional offices across Haryana to assist applicants.

The scheme is a part of the broader welfare initiatives aimed at improving the living conditions of workers and their families.

In the year 2022, the Haryana Labour Welfare Board reported that over 1,500 families benefited from this financial assistance scheme.

This indicates the scheme's reach and its importance in providing timely support to families in distress.

The financial assistance is not subject to any income ceiling.

This means that even families with higher incomes can apply for the assistance if they meet other eligibility criteria.

The scheme is particularly beneficial for families in rural areas where the loss of a worker can lead to severe economic challenges.

The Haryana government has made provisions to ensure that the application process is straightforward and accessible.

Awareness campaigns are conducted to inform workers and their families about the benefits of this scheme.

These campaigns are essential in ensuring that eligible families do not miss out on the assistance available to them.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board also collaborates with various NGOs and community organizations to reach out to potential beneficiaries.

The scheme has been positively received by the public and has been instrumental in providing financial relief.

In addition to the one-time financial assistance, the Haryana Labour Welfare Board also offers other welfare schemes for workers.

These include schemes for health insurance, educational assistance for children, and housing support.

The comprehensive approach of the Haryana Labour Welfare Board aims to create a safety net for workers and their families.

The financial assistance scheme for widows and dependents is a critical component of this safety net.

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to social justice and worker welfare.

It acknowledges the sacrifices made by workers and aims to support their families in times of need.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board continues to monitor and evaluate the scheme to enhance its effectiveness.

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account to improve the application process and disbursement of funds.

In conclusion, the Financial Assistance to Widow/Dependent in case of Death of a Worker scheme is a vital initiative by the Haryana government.

It provides essential financial support to families who have lost their primary earners.

The scheme is designed to be accessible and straightforward, ensuring that eligible families can receive the assistance they need.

With a one-time payment of ₹2,00,000, the scheme aims to alleviate the financial burden faced by widows and dependents.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board plays a crucial role in implementing this scheme and ensuring that it reaches those in need.
